posts.text: As a longtime supporter of MCOOL for beef, I thank President Trump for his executive order on mandatory country of origin labeling. South Dakota ranchers deserve a fair labeling system that provides consumers with basic information on the origin of the food that’s on their family’s dinner table. I’m proud that my legislation to reinstate MCOOL for beef, which would codify this executive order, is included in the Senate farm bill, and I remain committed to working to get it across the finish line

posts.text: I’m glad that congressional Republicans not only prioritized removing the threat of another dangerous government shutdown, but we did our job weeks before the deadline and with bipartisan support. While funding the government is one of our most basic responsibilities, my hope is that this effort proves that government shutdowns serve no one, and we should quickly complete our work on the fiscal year 2027 appropriations process.
posts.summary: Praises Republicans for passing bipartisan funding bill ahead of deadline

The year-round sale of E15 will be a huge win for producers in South Dakota and will boost the agriculture economy and rural communities across the country.

Passage of a farm bill is vital to give producers certainty in the years ahead, and I remain committed to getting it to the president’s desk to secure critical wins for South Dakota’s farmers and ranchers.
